claims.statement: The ECB explains that its reference rates are informational averages and may differ from actual transaction rates; realized client rate, explicit fees, and executable alternatives can therefore be reconciled, but savings cannot be inferred from the ECB rate alone.
The intended payer is the SME finance owner whose budget bears bank charges and conversion costs; the minimum recoverable volume and willingness to share savings remain unverified.

Client CSV exports are the simplest control path; if account-information access is used, EBA guidance says explicit payment-service-user consent is required, so the founder must work through a properly authorized access provider rather than collect bank credentials.

The proposed service deliberately excludes payment initiation, custody, and execution; whether its recommendations constitute regulated investment or payment advice in Poland needs legal confirmation.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Independence, multi-provider comparison, transparent savings attribution, and no custody must justify a separate fee
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns its direct client relationship
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accountants and fractional CFOs with nonexclusive referrals plus direct outreach to import-heavy firms

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Diagnostic paid upfront; savings fee paid only after client-approved evidence and implementation
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 55-75% after analyst time; small or messy ledgers may be uneconomic
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Client onboarding, reconciliation, implementation tracking, and quarterly reports
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Legal boundary review, GDPR/security controls, professional insurance, and licensed AISP cost if used
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 4000-12000 PLN diagnostic plus 15-25% of first-year independently verified savings
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Data normalization, quote collection, secure storage, and senior review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Banks, payment fintechs, treasury advisers, and accountants may provide free audits tied to switching or execution revenue
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: For each historical conversion, the difference between the client's all-in realized cost and a documented contemporaneous executable alternative is a measurable leakage hypothesis
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Large currency volume, provider price change, budget variance, refinancing, or a new finance leader
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Quarterly audit and annual provider tender or policy refresh

contrary_evidence: ECB reference rates are explicitly not intended for transaction use, so a naive spread calculation would be misleading.
Payment providers can subsidize free audits with execution revenue and may undercut an independent service.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Nonexclusive 12-month data-rights and workflow-review agreement using exports or a licensed AISP partner with explicit client consent
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Accept client-generated CSV and invoice exports; never access an account or initiate a payment without the required authorization and regulated partner
critical_control_point.current_owner: The client owns its records and retains every payment and provider decision
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns its direct client relationship
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Client-supplied exports, explicit-consent data access through a properly authorized provider, and public informational rates are lawful acquisition paths subject to contract and regulatory review.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Founder company after the client signs a data-rights and advisory-scope agreement
critical_control_point.renewal: Quarterly monitoring opt-in with annual contract renewal
critical_control_point.subject: Client-authorized FX transaction ledger and quarterly provider-review checkpoint

economics.acquisition_route: Accountants, fractional CFOs, import associations, and targeted outbound

economics.founder_time: Three to five hours daily during early audits, with intake and reconciliation automation required before volume
economics.gross_margin_basis: Reusable ingestion and comparison logic with analyst review concentrated on reconciliation and quote validity
economics.payback: Fixed diagnostic should cover CAC and initial delivery; not yet validated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 4000-12000 PLN upfront diagnostic plus 15-25% of agreed first-year savings
economics.retention_or_repeat: Quarterly monitoring, annual tenders, and new-currency or new-supplier events

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned, anonymized observations of fee structures and realized implementation outcomes improve peer baselines
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs with recurring supplier payments or card spend in foreign currencies
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accountants, fractional CFOs, import associations, and direct data-led outreach
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed data audit, quote comparison, control recommendations, and quarterly leakage monitoring; no custody or payment execution
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Finance owner pays a fixed diagnostic fee and a percentage after verified implementation savings
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A monthly close reveals opaque spreads, fees, or inconsistent conversion routes across accounts and suppliers

founder_fit: Transaction normalization and counterfactual analysis align with data science and finance interests
Savings attribution is quantitative and auditable
The service can start with secure exports and scheduled work alongside employment
Referral distribution avoids constant public content or on-camera selling
risks: Bad counterfactuals could overstate savings and create disputes
Sensitive financial-data handling raises security obligations
One-off audits may not retain after a provider switch
Clients may act on recommendations that expose them to currency risk

structure.control_point: The client-contracted recurring review checkpoint before FX provider and routing decisions
structure.critical_dependency: Complete client transaction data and independently obtainable executable comparison quotes

thesis: Contract a recurring approval checkpoint over an importer's own bank, card, and invoice exports, quantify all-in foreign-exchange leakage against contemporaneous executable alternatives, and charge a share of independently verified savings without executing trades.
title: Client-Authorized FX Leakage Recovery Audit
uncertainties: Distribution of annual FX volume and spread among target SMEs
Availability of timestamped executable comparison quotes
Polish regulatory perimeter for treasury recommendations and referral compensation
